data.key: Dark Tapestry Mystery ~ Read the Tapestry
data.name: Read the Tapestry
data.description: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes meditating on the mysteries of the Dark Tapestry to send your mind to another plane and communicate with the strange or alien beings there. This functions as the contact other plane spell.
